messages:
faye: Quick usability follow-up from prototype tests: users missed the Apply step after switching GPU pools.
noah: noted. options: auto-apply with undo toast or make Apply much stronger.
zhou: leaning auto-apply with 500ms debounce + undo toast: 'Switched to pool A — Undo'. avoids friction.
cam: agree, add brief cost tile pulse animation to show change (respect prefers-reduced-motion).
a11y-bot: accessibility flag: cost tile updates need aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce new estimate.
faye: also keyboard: space should preview pool (no apply), enter to confirm selection. show keyboard hint on focus.
noah: microcopy: change 'Latency' to 'SLO target (p99 ms)' and helper link 'what is p99?'.
zhou: burst badge should be compact '2.4h' visually but chip aria-label='Burst remaining 2.4 hours'. badges must be aria-hidden.
cam: I'll implement debounce+toast and keyboard hints. faye: I'll do the copy + aria PR and schedule an a11y re-scan.
